title: Fix docker bind-mount footgun (whole repo into container)
acceptance: Container can no longer write host source/.env/compose; app source mounted read-only and user workspace is a separate dedicated volume.
notes: ./:/data/workspace lets a compromised container modify host repo = supply-chain risk.

title: Add keyed-lock to JSON state writes
acceptance: setHomepage/setToolEnabled/setSkillEnabled/oauth persist use withKeyedLock; concurrent writes no longer lose updates (covered by a race test).
notes: blog/project already locked; these four state files are unlocked read-modify-write -> lost updates under concurrency.

title: Homepage rollback + serve-time fallback
acceptance: site-state keeps previous-homepage history; if the live homepage project becomes unpublished/deleted, serve auto-falls back instead of hard 503; clear_homepage/rollback available.
notes: Currently single homepage state, no undo; deleted project = permanent 503.

title: Backup/restore + postgres schema migration tooling
acceptance: Documented + scripted pg_dump backup and .docker-data snapshot; versioned migrations replacing ad-hoc create-if-not-exists; pool.end() on shutdown.
notes: No backup automation, no real migration versioning, pg pool not closed on shutdown.

title: Real-device mobile QA runner (issue_0006)
acceptance: Tool output (1) explicitly distinguishes emulated-mobile vs real-device QA; (2) covers iOS and/or Android real/cloud device OR labels the gap as 'requires external real-device/cloud-device runner'; (3) reports safe-area handling, touch targets, virtual keyboard push-up, iOS scroll bounce, PWA install prompt, and device CPU/memory signal.
notes: issue_0006 reopened: analyze_webpage_visual uses Chromium emulation only — does NOT cover native virtual keyboard, iOS momentum scroll, PWA install prompt on device, or actual device performance. Integration options: BrowserStack Automate, AWS Device Farm, LambdaTest, Appium + local device, or explicit tool-level disclaimer. Estimate integration effort before scheduling. See .feedback/issues.json#issue_0006 for full acceptanceCriteria and reopenReason.

title: Resolve residual professional solo-piano workflow blockers
acceptance: issue_0156 is either fully resolved or split into narrower closed-loop tickets; init_project_git git add -A failure is reproduced/fixed or documented with a separate linked issue; strict handwritten score workflow has a verified end-to-end recipe from score authoring to clean render to QA.
notes: Backlog reconciliation found issue_0156 partially addressed by author_handwritten_music_score, score-driven QA metadata, clean_dry render, and /mnt/data guidance, but residual init_project_git/professional-score ergonomics need explicit follow-up.

title: Handle intentionally silent or muted SoundFont stems
acceptance: render_midi_with_soundfont can distinguish intentionally muted/empty comparison stems from accidental missing audio; muted stems are skipped or reported non-blockingly when explicitly marked, while accidental silent stems still fail closed.
notes: Covers issue_0166. Current fail-closed silent-stem guard protects production quality but blocks A/B renders where an instrument is intentionally muted.

title: Add explicit per-instrument or stem gain controls for music renders
acceptance: render_midi_with_soundfont exposes documented gain/mix controls separate from MIDI channelMap; schema examples make clear channelMap is for channel assignment, not volume; tests prove piano/cello balance can be set before normalization.
notes: Covers issue_0167. Agents tried passing gain objects to channelMap because the product lacked an obvious mix-control surface.

title: Improve music tool error recovery and natural aliases
acceptance: inspect_audio_quality clearly labels MP3 as unsupported or decodes it without false silence findings; export_music_project maps common aliases such as audio/html/license/readme or returns explicit examples; render_production_music reports missing minimal-manifest fields instead of throwing Cannot convert undefined or null to object.
notes: Covers issue_0168, issue_0169, and issue_0170 as one usability/error-recovery task.

title: Add MCP transport error monitoring and retry guidance
acceptance: Repeated connector-side 502 reports during write/patch flows can be correlated with server activity, rate limiting, or lack of server-side request receipt; docs explain how to distinguish upstream connector failures from Code-MCP handler failures and what retry/backoff evidence to collect.
notes: Covers issue_0163. The observed ConnectorClientServerError: 502 is not emitted by this codebase, but it should be monitored rather than left only in feedback.
